newsitem.title: USA: First USA sets $0.12 cash div, splits stock.
newsitem.headline: First USA sets $0.12 cash div, splits stock.

text.p: First USA Inc said Thursday it has increased its regular quarterly cash dividend 33 percent to $0.12 per share and authorized a two-for-one split of its common stock.
The dividend was set on a pre-split basis. It is payable November 12 to stockholders of record on October 28.
The two-for-one common stock split will be come in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend payable November 12 to stockholders of record on October 28, the company said.
The split will increase the number of common shares outstanding to about 121.8 million versus the current 60.9 million.
First USA also declared a dividend of $0.498 per share of outstanding 6-1/4 percent mandatory convertible preferred stock to shareholders of record on October 28 and payable on November 20.
First USA is a financial services company specializing in the credit card business.
